name: Anti-Slip Fridge & Shelf Mat | Waterproof Washable Liner for Kitchen Drawers Cabinets | Dark Grey
description:
Keep your home neat and hygienic with this multi-purpose anti-slip fridge and shelf mat. Made from durable waterproof and washable material, it protects surfaces from spills, stains, and scratches. Ideal for refrigerators, kitchen drawers, cabinets, and shelves, it prevents slipping while keeping items in place. Easy to cut and install, this reusable mat is the perfect solution for maintaining a clean and organized home.
Key Features Anti-slip surface keeps items stable and secure Waterproof, washable, and reusable for long-term use Multi-purpose – fridge, drawers, cabinets, tables, and more Customizable – easily cut to fit any surface size Durable non-toxic EVA material, food-safe and eco-friendly Protects against spills, stains, moisture, and odors
Ingredients / MaterialsHigh-Quality EVA Plastic (Food-Safe, Non-Toxic)
How to Use Measure and cut the mat to desired size Place on fridge shelf, drawer, or cabinet surface Wipe clean or wash with water when needed
Package Includes 1 × Anti-Slip Fridge & Shelf Mat
